newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Armato lists on Johannesburg bourse.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Armato lists on Johannesburg bourse.

text.p: Armato Corp Ltd will list on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange with effect from Tuesday.
Armato, through its wholly owned subsidiary Collondale Consumer Products, is a manufacturer and distributor of snack foods and confectionery and a miller of maize.

The JSE has agreed to re-instate the listing of the company's existing shares under the abbreviated name Armato in the Industrial- Food sector of the JSE lists adjusted for the consolidation of its existing shares on the basis of one consolidated share for each 25 existing shares.

The JSE has also granted a listing of 50.8 million consolidated shares pursuant to the acquistion of Collondale, the one million shares issued to the Armato Share Incentive Trust and the three million shares issued for cash at 190 cents per share.
Armato has authorised share capital of 130 million ordinary shares and issued share capital of 57 million ordinary shares.
Its stated capital is 72.7 million rand.
For the 12 months ending June 30, 1997, Armato forecasts attributable earnings of 14.7 million rand.
